name: BeamDrop
highlights: 📡 Nearby Radar: AirDrop-style Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Device Discovery with Accept/Decline order security
📓 Smart Ephemeral Notebook: Text, code, and links beam straight into an interactive, zero-latency notebook
⚡ Zero-ZIP 1-Click Auto Upgrade Engine: Direct in-place rebuild & reload with 0 manual ZIP downloads or file extraction
🔄 In-Popup Instant Reload: Force reload files from disk directly with a single click

changelog.title: Nearby Radar, Ephemeral Notebook & Zero-ZIP Auto Upgrade Engine
changes: Nearby Radar: 360 sweeping radar scanning for local Wi-Fi devices and Web Bluetooth LE peers
AirDrop-style Handshake Modal: Recipient must explicitly Accept or Decline incoming transfer before data streaming begins
Zero-ZIP 1-Click Auto Upgrade: Instant in-place rebuild and reload directly inside Chrome without downloading or extracting ZIPs
Smart Notebook Engine: Auto-detects notes, code syntax (JS/Python/SQL), and URL web cards
In-Popup Instant Reload button: Reloads disk changes in 0.1s without opening chrome://extensions

changelog.title: BeamDrop Ephemeral Live Notebook & Pure OTA Engine
changes: Interactive Digital Notebook page: Scanned text, code, and links open directly in an interactive notebook
Code canvas with line numbers, code copy, and smart syntax detection
Save as File button (.txt, .md, .js, .py) directly from recipient device
Smart URL detection with 1-click browser navigation
Removed test simulator from Updates tab for a pure, clean, fast OTA update experience
Multi-file in-memory ZIP bundling with JSZip

changelog.title: Automated Package Downloader & Dual GitHub/Vercel Sync
changes: Direct chrome.downloads API integration: downloads new extension.zip directly to user machine
Dual-cloud polling: Checks Vercel + raw.githubusercontent.com simultaneously with cache-busting
Native Chrome desktop notification when a new version is pushed to GitHub/Vercel

changelog.title: 1-Click Fast Updater & Background Notification Engine
changes: In-extension fast updater interface: update directly without removing or re-adding the extension in Chrome
Toolbar notification badge ('NEW') when a new GitHub/Vercel release is published
Periodic background watcher to alert users automatically of new releases
Integrated TURN relay for high-speed transfer across firewalls
